title: Count monthly totals for non reps/time habits and simplify habit editing UI

requirements.text: Update monthly total calculations and display for habits whose unit type is neither "reps" nor "time": the monthly total must equal the number of selected day checkboxes (each checked day counts as +1), and the UI must show both the monthly total and the goal in the existing monthly totals/volumes area for the habit row.

quotes: For the monthly totals: yes but only change the habits that are not reps and time - provide the goal where the monthly volumes are on the app

acceptanceCriteria: For a habit with unitType not equal to "reps" and not equal to "time", checking N days in a given month results in a displayed monthly total of N for that month.
For a habit with unitType "reps", the monthly total continues to be calculated as (per-completion volume for the month) × (completed days count) and displayed as it is today.
For a habit with unitType "time", the monthly total continues to be calculated as (per-completion minutes for the month) × (completed days count) and displayed as it is today (formatted time string).

For non-(reps/time) habits, the goal shown in the monthly total/volume area is the habit’s configured monthly volume value for that selected month (i.e., the same value currently edited/displayed in the habit’s volume field for the month).
User-facing labels are in English (e.g., "Monthly total" and "Goal").

requirements.text: Ensure the "16/8 fasting" habit follows the non-(reps/time) monthly total behavior: monthly total increments by 1 per checked day and displays the goal alongside the monthly total in the existing monthly totals/volumes area.
acceptanceCriteria: When the unit type for the "16/8 fasting" habit is set to anything other than "reps" or "time", its monthly total equals the number of checked days in the selected month.
The monthly total/goal display for the "16/8 fasting" habit uses the same layout as other habits and appears in the existing monthly total row area.

requirements.text: Revise the habit editing UI so edit controls are not visible on the main grid: remove the always/hover-visible inline edit buttons for name/unit/volume from the habit row, and instead make clicking/tapping a habit open a small pop-up with a single edit-pen action; selecting the pen must open a full habit edit modal that allows changing all habit details currently editable in the app (including name, unit type, and the selected month’s volume/goal).

quotes: Can you change the edit options on the attached so they aren’t as obvious on the main screen? Have it that when I click on the habit then it pops up one edit pen and from there it allows me to change all details of the habit.

acceptanceCriteria: On the main habit grid, the per-field pencil/edit buttons for name/unit/volume are no longer shown (including on hover and on touch devices).
Clicking/tapping a habit row (or its habit-info cell) opens a contextual pop-up that displays a single pencil/edit action (not multiple edit icons).

Clicking/tapping the pencil/edit action opens a modal dialog where the user can edit: habit name, unit type, and the selected month’s volume/goal value (with the same validation rules currently used for time vs non-time volume input).
Saving changes from the modal updates the habit via the existing mutations and refresh/optimistically updates the grid accordingly.
Cancel/close leaves the habit unchanged and closes the modal.

constraints: Backend remains single-actor (all Motoko logic in backend/main.mo).
Do not edit files under frontend/src/components/ui or any immutable paths listed in SYSTEM_CONTEXT.
Use English for all user-facing text.
nonGoals: Adding new backend data fields or changing the Motoko habit schema.
Implementing third-party authentication (only Internet Identity remains).
Adding new habit types beyond using the existing unitType mechanism.
